Jewelry Valuation Widget for Your Website

Add a simple, reliable jewelry valuation widget to your site and start receiving verified local leads from people looking to sell gold, get an appraisal, or buy an engagement ring. The first three leads are free, and each accepted lead costs $40. A monthly subscription of $29 gives you a customizable valuation widget that fits seamlessly into your website.

How It Works

  1. Embed the Widget – Add a few lines of code to your site. No account or special setup is required.
  2. Capture Leads – Visitors enter their jewelry details and contact information. The widget validates the data and sends it directly to your inbox.
  3. Get Verified Leads – Each lead is vetted by CaratBase’s network of independent jewelers, estate buyers, and appraisers. You only pay for leads that you accept.
  4. Grow Your Business – Use the leads to offer appraisals, sell gold, or sell engagement rings. The widget is available in Atlanta first, with plans to expand to other metro areas.

What You Receive

  • Verified Local Leads – People in your service area actively looking for jewelry services.
  • No Initial Cost – The first three leads are free. After that, each accepted lead costs $40.
  • Monthly Widget Subscription – $29/month for a fully customizable valuation widget that can be branded to match your website.
  • US‑Focused Service – All leads are from the United States, ensuring relevance and higher conversion rates.

Why Choose CaratBase

  • Trusted Network – CaratBase partners with independent jewelers, estate buyers, and appraisers to deliver high‑quality leads.
  • Transparent Pricing – Pay only for the leads you accept; no hidden fees.
  • Easy Integration – Embed the widget with minimal effort and start receiving leads immediately.
  • Scalable – Begin in Atlanta and expand to additional metro areas as your business grows.

FAQ

Q: How many leads do I get for free? A: You receive the first three leads at no cost. After that, each accepted lead costs $40.

Q: What is the cost of the valuation widget? A: The widget is available for $29 per month, giving you a customizable tool that integrates directly into your website.

Q: Do I need to create an account to use the widget? A: No account is required to embed the widget. You can start collecting leads immediately.

Next Step

Ready to start receiving verified local leads? Visit CaratBase and sign up today to add the jewelry valuation widget to your website.
